review_locator: PMCID:PMC4803555, Small Heterodimer Partner and Innate Immune Regulation
primary_title: Small heterodimer partner interacts with NLRP3 and negatively regulates activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome
decision_basis: Primary evidence supports activation-induced direct SHP-NLRP3 PYD binding, ASC competition and negative regulation of inflammasome assembly
limitations_preserved: Preserve activation-induced mitochondrial/perinuclear context, ASC competition, mouse/human limits and no nuclear-receptor or terminal-TF inference.
